verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll product, so running an off-cycle payroll is an applicable axis. However, no evidence describes running an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations. The only nearby evidence is the 'Pay > Make a Payment > Record a Payment' path, which the docs describe only for recording taxable fringe benefits provided outside Justworks. That is an adjacent feature, not an off-cycle payroll run.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule
